title: Workshop: build a day-out guide
summary: Turn the plain lines of a walk guide into real lists: a packing list with a nested list, numbered directions, a continued list, a glossary and a menu of links.
intro: a day-out guide for a walk. At the start, every list is plain lines of text, so the browser runs them together. One step at a time, you will add an unordered packing list with a nested list, numbered directions, a numbered list that continues from them, a description list for a glossary, a menu of links inside a nav, a link inside a list item, and a small rule that removes the bullets from the menu.
